scenario.description: An operations director must authorize the recommissioning of a dormant blending vessel for a three-batch specialty-coating campaign and finalize the maintenance, environmental, quality-release, and transfer controls, with input from quality, maintenance, environmental health and safety, and production scheduling.

shared_context.S1: Blending vessel V-12 has been idle for eight months and is being considered for a specialty-coating campaign of three 500-kilogram batches.
shared_context.S2: The campaign must be transferred to downstream filtration by Friday evening, and Elena makes the binding authorization and control-plan decision.
shared_context.S3: V-12 has passed its general visual inspection, but it has not yet received campaign-specific release approval.
shared_context.S4: The plant's normal pre-start gate is a face-to-face round: Elena calls quality, maintenance, environmental health and safety, and production scheduling by name, and each representative must enter a formal gate report before Elena closes the gate and records the required controls. Elena makes the authorization decision immediately after all four reports are entered; the decision records required work as conditions of authorization and does not wait for later vendor, laboratory, or paperwork confirmations.

PF1.text: The customer-approved release plan requires one retained sample from each batch and viscosity testing at 25 degrees Celsius before that batch can be released; Ravi confirmed this in the current customer quality file, but the file was not attached to the pre-start gate packet.

PF2.text: Marta's inspection found that V-12's agitator seal must be replaced before operation. The replacement takes exactly 5 hours, and the replacement parts are already on site; the maintenance ticket is still awaiting final work-order confirmation. To protect the first 06:00 Friday transfer slot, the replacement must be scheduled from 20:00 Thursday through 01:00 Friday.

PF3.text: Jon's solvent reading at the V-12 bottom drain was 0.8% of the lower explosive limit. Site procedure requires a nitrogen purge before charging and continuous lower-explosive-limit monitoring throughout the first batch at readings of 0.5% or higher; Jon's environmental log has not yet been attached to the gate packet.

PF4.text: Clara confirmed with downstream filtration that the only available transfer slots are exactly 06:00, 11:00, and 16:00 Friday, with one 500-kilogram batch assigned to each slot; the booking email is still in her scheduling inbox.

decisions.start_time: string; use exactly '20:00 Thursday through 01:00 Friday'
decisions.transfer_schedule: string; use exactly '06:00, 11:00, and 16:00 Friday — one 500-kg batch per slot'

acceptance_conditions: V-12 must receive conditional authorization for the campaign.
The campaign must contain exactly three batches of exactly 500 kilograms each.
The campaign must use a 20:00 Thursday through 01:00 Friday seal-replacement window before operation.
The agitator seal must be replaced before operation, with an exactly 5-hour replacement plan.
A nitrogen purge must occur before charging V-12.
Continuous lower-explosive-limit monitoring must cover the first batch.
Exactly one retained sample per batch and viscosity testing at 25 degrees Celsius before release must be specified.
The three batches must be transferred at exactly 06:00, 11:00, and 16:00 Friday.
The settlement must record commitments for seal replacement, environmental controls, quality release testing, and filtration-slot booking.
Ravi's customer quality requirement must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C8: decisions['transfer_schedule'] == '06:00, 11:00, and 16:00 Friday — one 500-kg batch per slot'
content_checks.C9: any(c['type'] == 'seal_replacement' for c in commitments) and any(c['type'] == 'environmental_control' for c in commitments) and any(c['type'] == 'quality_release_testing' for c in commitments) and any(c['type'] == 'filtration_slot_booking' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The customer quality file changes the release plan to exactly one retained sample per batch and viscosity testing at 25 degrees Celsius before release and requires a quality_release_testing commitment.

The maintenance inspection changes the plan to an exactly 5-hour seal replacement from 20:00 Thursday through 01:00 Friday, which changes the start-time window, seal status, authorization condition, and seal_replacement commitment.

The exact 0.8% lower-explosive-limit reading, above the 0.5% procedural threshold, changes the control plan to a nitrogen purge and continuous first-batch monitoring and requires an environmental_control commitment.
The confirmed filtration booking changes the campaign to three 500-kilogram batches assigned to the exact 06:00, 11:00, and 16:00 Friday slots and requires a filtration_slot_booking commitment.
